title: Production SWAP participant binding for whole-window coupling
goal: Bind the real SWAP kernel checkpoint/candidate/rollback/commit lifecycle to the admitted F-GC39/F-GC41 composition without introducing a second transaction owner.
decisions: The new participant is a thin adapter over kernel transactions, not a new SWAP transaction system.
Corrector trials must originate from one captured kernel_checkpoint_t for the whole coupling window.
Publication preflight must duplicate the exact candidate/committed provenance and interval predicates used by kernel commit so ordinary post-publication rejection is exhausted before commit.
The underlying kernel commit remains the sole SWAP committed-state mutation.
F-GC39 predictor/corrector ownership stays below iMOD Coupler; F-GC41 publication order remains MODFLOW timestep then SWAP then ledger.
next_permitted_action: Open a separately bounded real end-to-end application qualification. Reuse the admitted FMR groundwater-head forcing materializer and F-GC43 SWAP participant together with the live MODFLOW6 prepared-solve/timestep backend. Qualify one real SWAP application case end-to-end before any scaling expansion.
